3. المؤثرون

• الباحثون

• الجامعات

• الجهات التنظيمية

اًلستنتاج:

السوق متعدد الطبقات، وقرار الشراء مؤسسي جماعي

🔷 ثالثاا: تحليل الطلب (Clinical Demand)

الطلب هنا ليس “شراء” بل:

اعتماد عالجي (Therapeutic Adoption)

ما الذي يحدد الطلب؟

1. فعالية الدواء (Efficacy)

2. األمان (Safety)

3. مقارنة بالعالجات الحالية

4. النتائج السريرية (Clinical Outcomes)

نوع الطلب:

• بطيء في البداية

• ثم يتسارع بعد اإلثبات

يسمى:

Evidence-Based Demand

reference.method: Draft from the text layer as recovered by two black-box extractors (poppler pdftotext reading-order mode; MuPDF via its Python binding), compared with each other and, for Latin text, with tesseract OCR of the rendered page; every scored page then compared with its rendered image: block order, completeness, columns, headers and footers corrected. Characters are the text layer, not re-read from pixels.
reference.notes: Arabic with Latin terms in parentheses, written in logical order: list numbers precede their text, parentheses enclose the Latin term. Producer defects of the ToUnicode map (missing lam-alef in several words, a doubled alef) are kept because they are what an extractor can recover. Headings, list items, bullets and the two pin icons compared with the page image; the pin and diamond icons are emoji glyphs where the layer has them.
